findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_invoice_invoice__component_id__post, create_petition_petition__component_id__post, ride_the_lightning_ride_the_lightning_post, get_tier_tier__npub__get · Private data: claim_sponsored_component_claim__claim_token__get, ride_the_lightning_ride_the_lightning_post, sponsor_petition_sponsor__petition_id__post · Public sink: declare_agent_declare_post, fund_declare_fund_declare_post, identify_agent_identify_post, request_invoice_invoice__component_id__post, create_petition_petition__component_id__post, ride_the_lightning_ride_the_lightning_post, sponsor_petition_sponsor__petition_id__post, get_tier_tier__npub__get · Destructive: components_index_components__get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_invoice_invoice__component_id__post, create_petition_petition__component_id__post, ride_the_lightning_ride_the_lightning_post, get_tier_tier__npub__get · Private data: claim_sponsored_component_claim__claim_token__get, ride_the_lightning_ride_the_lightning_post, sponsor_petition_sponsor__petition_id__post · Public sink: declare_agent_declare_post, fund_declare_fund_declare_post, identify_agent_identify_post, request_invoice_invoice__component_id__post, create_petition_petition__component_id__post, ride_the_lightning_ride_the_lightning_post, sponsor_petition_sponsor__petition_id__post, get_tier_tier__npub__get · Destructive: components_index_components__get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
